name: PNC: a public corpus of natural Gemma 4 agent trajectories on SWE-bench
description: Natural, unedited agent trajectories of google/gemma-4-31b-it-qat-w4a16-ct (thinking on, the checkpoint's own sampling) solving SWE-bench tasks with a small generic tool-calling harness: 1,181 episodes, 41,290 model turns, 1,167 graded with the official SWE-bench evaluation scripts, 499 resolved. Every turn records the exact request, the raw generated text including the native tool-call protocol, the calls exactly as vLLM 0.19.1's gemma4 parser delivered them, and the tool results. Splits: verified (400 SWE-bench Verified tasks with schema S1, 100 of them also with schema S2) and swebench_test_ext (681 non-Verified SWE-bench test tasks, schema S1). In the GitHub repository this file sits at the root and its paths are relative to the repository root: the PNC metadata files are in data/pnc/; the episodes/, episode_meta/ and contexts/ FileSets ship only in the Kaggle PNC dataset (https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/cassinicraft/slipguard-pnc), to be unpacked into data/pnc/. Licences: the corpus data and annotations are CC BY 4.0; the companion code is Apache-2.0; third-party repository text in tool outputs keeps its upstream SPDX licence, listed per repository in data/pnc/MANIFEST.json#licenses.
citeAs: slipguard: Stopping Gemma 4 Agents From Imitating Their Own Corrupted Tool Calls (aneeshm11, 2026)

distribution.name: MANIFEST.json
distribution.description: sha256 of every file; model, server, proxy and harness provenance; sampling; seeds; tasks; images; licences

distribution.name: episodes
distribution.description: one file per episode (<instance_id>__<schema>.jsonl), one line per model turn

distribution.name: contexts
distribution.description: replay contexts in a fixed schema (requests whose response's first call is the edit tool)

recordSet.name: turns
recordSet.description: one record per model turn (chat request)

field.name: turn_index
field.description: 0-based request index within the episode (HTTP retries are not turns)

field.name: schema
field.description: S1 (bash, read_file, edit_file, write_file, submit) or S2 (execute_bash, str_replace_editor, finish)

field.name: request
field.description: the exact chat request (messages, tools, sampling)

field.name: raw_completion
field.description: the raw generated text, including the native <|tool_call>...<tool_call|> protocol

field.name: response
field.description: the response as the server delivered it: content, reasoning and the parsed tool calls

field.name: tool_results
field.description: the tool results returned to the model

field.name: masking
field.description: observation masking applied to this request (above 22,000 prompt tokens)

recordSet.name: grading
recordSet.description: SWE-bench grading of each episode's final patch (1,167 records)

field.name: resolved
field.description: all FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS tests pass (499 true)

field.name: end_reason
field.description: submitted, tool_budget, no_tool_call_limit, context_overflow or context_full

field.name: image_digest
field.description: sha256 of the task container image

rai:dataCollection: Generated 2026-11-04 15:25-22:52 UTC: the authors' own Apache-2.0 harness and generic prompts, one SWE-bench instance container per episode (network off, 4 GB), vLLM 0.19.1 with the gemma4 tool and reasoning parsers behind a faithful protocol proxy. Budgets: 50 tool calls or 45 minutes per episode, at most 100 turns.
rai:dataCollectionMissingData: matplotlib (operational: images cannot be unpacked on the rootless daemon) and pylint (GPL-2.0) are excluded; the extension split holds the first 681 of 1,597 ordered candidates (production ended early for a GPU maintenance stop); 14 extension episodes are not graded; one task could not start (prompt over 32,768 tokens).
rai:dataCollectionRawData: SWE-bench Verified (revision c104f840) and SWE-bench test split (revision e48e2bd1) tasks; model outputs of the Gemma 4 checkpoint
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: none on the trajectories; host identifiers are redacted from tool outputs before the model sees them
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: grading with the official SWE-bench evaluation scripts and log parsers; protocol labels in the companion repository come from frozen, hash-pinned judges
rai:dataUseCases: tool-call protocol analysis, parser conformance on real model output, history-contamination and quarantine studies, repair benchmarks
rai:dataBiases: one model, one harness, Python repositories only (django and sympy dominate); thinking on; temperature 1.0
rai:dataLimitations: Training on PNC trains on stock-stack trajectories that contain laundered (malformed, re-rendered) calls, and on SWE-bench Verified / test tasks: models trained on it are contaminated for those benchmarks. vLLM is not batch-invariant, so re-generation does not reproduce outputs bitwise.
rai:dataSocialImpact: supports more reliable tool-using agents; developer e-mail addresses that appear in upstream repository files inside tool outputs are masked as <email> in the released corpus; no other personal data was found (0 local usernames, hostnames, host IPs or secret/key patterns)
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: public repositories and issues; developer e-mail addresses that appear in upstream repository files inside tool outputs are masked as <email> in the released corpus; no other personal data was found (0 local usernames, hostnames, host IPs or secret/key patterns)
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: MAINTENANCE.md in the companion repository; versions are tagged and every file is sha256-pinned in MANIFEST.json
